title: 2008 AMC 8 Problem 2
statement: The ten-letter code \(\text{BEST OF LUCK}\) represents the ten digits \(0-9,\) in order. What \(4\)-digit number is represented by the code word \(\text{CLUE}?\)

solutions.text:
The code BEST OF LUCK represents the digits \(0\) through \(9\) in order, so \(C=8\), \(L=6\), \(U=7\), and \(E=1\).

Therefore, \(\text{CLUE}=8671\).

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Write the digit under each letter in BEST OF LUCK.
Because the first letter represents \(0,\) each letter represents one less than its position in the code.
